styleSelection.reason: The reference is a painted village and olive hillside with readable dark roof and opening lines. A restrained pen drawing should carry the small architecture while a single light wash family keeps the foliage and walls broad.

families.referenceCue: The prominent right-center cluster of ochre tile roofs, pale sunlit facades, cool side planes and dark window recesses. Read roof direction and wall planes before adding small accents.
Small pale stone houses and roof fragments along the upper ridge, separated by cypress and olive canopy; keep the warm planes light and their edges interrupted by foliage.
Connected yellow-olive and cool-green tree masses fill the lower half and thread between houses. Treat them as broad value shapes; the individual leaf marks are below this wash's resolution.
